a.lede: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed on Tuesday that it's investigating a "cybersecurity incident." The bureau, which is part of the Treasury Department, said it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems."
